description: This file defines interfaces and functions for building booking-related links (cancel and reschedule) for different platforms and standard URLs, with logic to choose platform-specific or standard links based on parameters.

methods.name: buildPlatformCancelLink
methods.description: Constructs a platform-specific cancel link URL with query parameters.

methods.name: buildPlatformRescheduleLink
methods.description: Constructs a platform-specific reschedule link URL with query parameters.

methods.name: buildStandardCancelLink
methods.description: Constructs a standard (non-platform) cancel link URL with query parameters.

methods.name: buildStandardRescheduleLink
methods.description: Constructs a standard (non-platform) reschedule link URL with query parameters.

methods.name: buildCancelLink
methods.description: Chooses between platform-specific or standard cancel link based on parameters.

methods.name: buildRescheduleLink
methods.description: Chooses between platform-specific or standard reschedule link based on parameters.
